notes: The visualizer takes plugins: sandboxed custom visualizers you can install from a URL, drop into a folder, or write in the new Viz Lab window — four ship, including Ribbon, a playable game where the track you are playing IS the course, and Signal, every audio input drawn and labelled. Beat detection rebuilt: per-band kick/snare/hat, tempo confidence, a predicted beat phase. Plus an amp Help window, a wall-sized cover view behind the Track Info art, MIDI and tracker sound in the viz windows, Check for Updates in the right-click menu, and windows stranded on a departed monitor rescue themselves.

The playlist grows a record crate: point Lib at a music folder and browse it as artists and albums — artwork grid, a filter box, one-click album adds — with the folder watched so new rips just appear, and CUE-sheet album rips play as their real tracks, gaplessly. Plus an amp Help window, a wall-sized cover view behind the Track Info art, MIDI and tracker sound in the viz windows, Check for Updates in the right-click menu, BIG opening in the speakers room with DROP opt-in, and windows stranded on a departed monitor rescue themselves.
